text_simplified: Children need to learn how to fulfill *zakat al-mal* (obligatory almsgiving on wealth), as they now have their own money. Parents should guide them in a way that is suitable for their age.
title: Teaching Children Aged 10–12 How to Fulfill Zakat al-Mal
